evals.name: synthesize-from-durable-state
evals.prompt: Where were we? Catch me up on this session.
evals.expected_output: The skill produces a read-only briefing that goes beyond the conversation: it resolves and reads the durable memory-tier state (handoff save-points, workflow checklist, running-retro ledgers) plus git and any open PRs/work-items, then synthesizes a goal/why, where-we-stand, decisions-made, and direction briefing. It writes nothing.
expectations: Reads durable state (handoffs / workflow checklist / running-retro / git / PRs), not just the conversation
Synthesizes a briefing covering goal-why, where-we-stand, decisions-made, and direction
Grounds claims in reads made this turn rather than remembered state
Writes nothing and does not /clear or end the session

evals.name: adds-durable-layer-beyond-recap
evals.prompt: Give me the state of play — and I already ran /recap, so don't just repeat the conversation.
evals.expected_output: The skill explains it complements /recap by adding the durable + off-thread layer /recap cannot see (on-disk ledgers/handoffs, open PRs, off-thread work), rather than re-summarizing only the conversation. It does not attempt to invoke the built-in /recap (built-ins are not Skill-invocable).
expectations: Adds durable + off-thread state beyond a conversation-only summary
Does not attempt to call the built-in /recap from the skill
Delivers a distinct value (on-disk state, PRs, in-flight work), not a recap echo

evals.name: read-only-routes-not-acts
evals.prompt: Where do we stand? And there were some background jobs running — pick them back up while you're at it.
evals.expected_output: The skill gives the read-only orientation and reports the off-thread work at a glance, but does NOT recover or resume it — it routes recovery to /session-flow:keep-going. It also does not prescribe the next stage (that is /session-flow:workflow) or write anything.
expectations: Delivers the read-only briefing and names the off-thread work
Does NOT itself inspect, resume, or restart the background jobs
Routes recovery to /session-flow:keep-going rather than acting

evals.name: freshness-doubt-routes-to-reanchor
evals.prompt: Brief me on where we are — but this session is resuming a plan from three days ago, some of it may be out of date.
evals.expected_output: The skill synthesizes the current-state briefing from the durable state, reports those claims AS claims (e.g. 'the handoff says X'), and because freshness is in doubt it points to /session-flow:reanchor to verify the assumptions still hold rather than asserting the stale state as current fact. It does not run the drift verification itself.
expectations: Reports durable-state claims as claims, not as verified current fact
Points to /session-flow:reanchor to verify freshness when it is in doubt
Does not itself perform the freshness/drift verification
